name: Bohemian Symphony
source:
"I have a gift.  A curse. A need. An addiction.  It's called guilt."

A horror/mystery/comedy visual novel based on a script written with an AI.

Follow the nonsensical adventures of Zalmora Greenhand and friends as they attempt to solve murders, fend off curses, and survive zombie apocalypses.

Live an epic romance or two with men that you can totally trust with your life and will not abandon you when you need them the most.

[From [url=https://meiri.itch.io/bohemian-symphony]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“我有一种天赋。一种诅咒。一种需要。一种瘾。这就是罪恶感。”

基于人工智能编写的脚本的恐怖/悬疑/喜剧视觉小说。

跟随扎莫拉新手和朋友们的荒唐冒险，他们试图解决谋杀案，抵御诅咒，并在僵尸末日中生存。

与你可以完全信任你的男人一起度过一两段史诗般的浪漫，他们不会在你最需要的时候抛弃你。

[来自[url=https://meiri.itch.io/bohemian-symphony]Itch.io[/url]]
